caption: The drawing depicts a single figurine of a lion, which is brown in color and appears to be made of a ceramic or clay material. The lion is shown reclining on its belly with its front paws extended and its hind legs tucked under its body, all resting on an oval base of the same material and color. The lion has a textured mane that frames its face and flows down to its shoulders. The facial features of the lion, including round eyes, a pronounced nose, and a defined mouth with a hint of whiskers, are clearly visible. There is some visible surface wear and small chips, especially on the base. The lion figurine is positioned on a flat, horizontal, wood-textured surface that spans the bottom of the composition. The background is plain and off-white in color. Above the lion, there is printed text in uppercase letters that reads: "FIGURINE LION SIGNED 'JOHN SANDERS 1817'." The entire composition is centered on the figurine and the textual information above it.
title: Lion
